note: Planning ids only. PLANNED means specified in this packet. UNSATISFIED means the packet requires a property the cited sources do not show as passed. Neither token means implemented.

requirements.statement: Customer root holds title to customer authority. Vantio is not a member of the root set.
Host title stays with the customer. Enterprise stores enroll and retire intent. Phantom Engine on that host is the enroll mechanism.
Policy intent is a versioned customer decision. Host attachment is a separate state.
Export, hash, rollback, and uninstall remain customer-sufficient. The only recoverable evidence copy is not Vantio-only.
Grants and approvals are customer-owned records. A missing Vantio copy does not erase them.
Kernel enforcement, Optics observation, and billing stay outside Enterprise title.
Grant scope is a subset of the delegator's envelope at approval time.
not_before and not_after are required. Duration numbers stay NOT_SET.
Workloads do not hold or receive security or recovery authority.
Process spawn does not mint a grant.
Redelegation is forbidden until EG-D1 is decided otherwise.
ACTIVE is a host report. APPROVED is not attachment.
Revocation returns exercise and leaves title with the customer root.
Expiry and revocation leave no expanded authority.
Every proposal has one approval class. A missing class is refused.
WIDEN requires two distinct customer identities. Same-person approval is refused.
RECOVERY completes with the customer party and without Vantio.
NARROW cannot appoint Vantio, erase evidence, or mark a host protected.
Root-set, recovery-party, and Vantio-witness removal stay at ROOT.

Vantio-only freeze, revoke, and recover, unsigned loosening, console attachment, workload self-approval, same-person dual control, wider-than-ceiling restore, dry-run-as-activation, and a second enforcement engine are REJECTED.
Recovery stays inside last-known, observe-only, and stay-quarantined, and does not restore a wider envelope.
Customer one-shot freeze on a host Vantio does not operate.
An Enterprise approval is a proposal until the host reports a matching active version.
Enterprise does not mark a host protected, enrolled, or enforced.
If the Enterprise record store is unavailable, last-known host enforcement continues and the envelope is not widened.
Open-core does not gain a second enforcement engine, a host loader, or an enroll command.
Free Optics stays observe-only and account-free.
A customer-owned on-host channel presents an approved record to Phantom Engine. The hosted store is not that channel.
Customer recovery party can freeze on a host Vantio does not operate, with Vantio unreachable and no Vantio credential.
Customer root can revoke a delegate and Vantio's witness role with every Vantio credential absent.
Recover with Vantio absent ends in last-known, observe-only, or stay-quarantined, inside the pre-containment envelope.
A Vantio-only credential attempting freeze, revoke, or recover is refused and host authority is unchanged.
Export, hash, rollback, and uninstall complete with Vantio absent, and the customer keeps the exported evidence.
